context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 features fully implemented and working: 1) OneDrive Excel sync endpoint exists at POST /api/sync/excel - triggers background sync from 'Wypłaty główny.xlsx' (col B=phone, col C=name, row 17+). Sync will fail with Azure auth error until Graph API permissions are configured in Azure portal. 2) PDF report generation at GET /api/reports/pdf/download?month=X&year=Y returns valid PDF. POST /api/reports/pdf triggers background generation + OneDrive upload (upload fails without Azure permissions). 3) >10h notification system: when hours_worked > 10, automatic notification created in 'notifications' collection. Admin can approve/reject via POST /api/notifications/{id}/approve or /reject. Notifications show in 'Prosby' tab with employee name, hours, date, and creator. Badge shows combined count of requests + notifications.
